decisions.reason: The remote screen-sharing support tool is not highly distinctive, but it supports implementation and customer service in the firm's core software business, so it is still worth retaining unless replaced by a more integrated support solution.

A practice performance analytics dashboard fits the firm's direction toward digital and efficiently managed practices and is close enough to the core software offering to justify continued support and development.
A complete dental practice bundle is closely aligned with the established business and should help win or retain practices, even if its exact packaging may evolve over time.

A job and practice listing portal is relatively far from the firm's core capabilities in practice software and support, so management would likely redeploy resources from it to the main product line or newer developments.
